title: An inch is exactly 2.54cm
hook: Which conversion avoids the shown rounding shortcut?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: The inch is defined as exactly 25.4 millimetres. Dividing centimetres by 2.54 gives inches; using 2.5 is a convenient approximation with a visible error that grows with length.

misconception: The two pictured methods are interchangeable without checking their mechanism or constraints.

claims.text: An inch is exactly 2.54 cm, so 127 ÷ 2.54 = 50 in. The 2.5 shortcut gives 50.8 in, and its error grows with length. The measurement itself still has its own uncertainty.
